opening.argument: The discussion is framed as market commentary on StrongBlock and STRONG, with the speaker presenting a personal, speculative view rather than a guaranteed result. He says, “I'm going to buy strong token right now so this is good up golden opportunity,” but describes a hoped-for outcome: “making a 2x 3x” before removing his principal, and expressly qualifies it as “not a financial advice, I'm just sharing my personal opinion.” The speaker also acknowledges that some people think it is “a rock pool,” showing that concerns and uncertainty are part of the discussion. While the interface displays staking and mining options and token rewards, these materials do not establish a fraudulent token sale or guaranteed payout mechanism.
